This rice plot is small, only 0.38 hectares, but rice needs good water and some fertilizer to give a proper harvest. I will buy a little NPK and urea from the agro-dealer if the subsidy reaches us, because without fertilizer the rice will not yield well on this tired soil. I cannot afford much pesticide or improved seed every year, so I will use seed I kept from last season and hope the rains come well. My wife and children will help me, but during transplanting and harvest I must hire some hands because the work is too much for the family alone.
